Retain the selected his without a following comma. The retained2025 hand missal prints his qui; Benziger printed320 and the retained DO transcript print his, qui. In the complete construction Quotquot ... dedit eis ... his qui credunt ... qui ... ex Deo nati sunt, his is dative plural in explanatory apposition to eis. The first nominative plural qui is the subject of credunt; the second is the subject of nati sunt and refers to the same recipients/believers, not singular eius. The printed comma variant does not alter these case/number relationships. Both punctuation forms are grammatically possible; retaining the attested selected omission does not claim that the Missal printed it or that punctuation never affects meaning. Witness readings remain literal. No substantive text or Polish/English wording change follows from this bounded ruling.
